known_issues: TensorRT requires per-engine calibration for INT8; build can be slow.
profiles.notes: Use TensorRT for maximum throughput; AWQ int4 from NVModelOpt is best for LLMs.

known_issues: Limited INT8 tensor core support; verify QDQ placement.
profiles.notes: T4 benefits from TensorRT INT8 but smaller batch sizes due to memory.

known_issues: OpenVINO EP on CPU can silently fall back to CPUExecutionProvider for unsupported ops.
profiles.notes: Static INT8 with QOperator is fastest on CPU; OpenVINO for CNNs.

known_issues: Operator whitelist is narrow; LayerNorm and GELU may need replacement.
Requires symmetric per-channel quantization.
profiles.notes: Use QNNPreprocess if available; verify opset compatibility.

known_issues: QNN ABI EP requires QAIRT SDK and QNN ABI-compatible runtime.
Operator whitelist is narrow; use SimplifiedLayerNormToRMSNorm for graph compatibility.
Requires symmetric per-channel quantization.
profiles.notes: New in olive-ai 0.13.0 (PR #2434). ABI-stable QNN execution provider; use QairtPipeline for single-pass LLM quantization+compilation. Prefer over legacy QNNExecutionProvider multi-step workflow.

known_issues: CoreML requires per-channel quantization for some layers.
Dynamic shapes are limited; fixed input shapes recommended for optimal ANE scheduling.
Requires coremltools for model conversion.
profiles.notes: CoreML targets the Apple Neural Engine and Apple GPU. Fixed input shapes recommended for optimal ANE scheduling. Requires coremltools for model conversion.

known_issues: NNAPI has strict quantization limits (often uint8 only).
Many ops not accelerated; fallback common.
profiles.notes: Keep model small and avoid unsupported ops.

known_issues: OpenVINO plugin must be installed separately.
profiles.notes: Use FP16 or INT8 on Intel iGPUs for best throughput.

known_issues: Power-of-2 scale constraint limits accuracy; use calibration carefully.
profiles.notes: Best for edge CNN workloads on Xilinx boards.

known_issues: Large batch sizes may need gradient checkpointing during calibration.
profiles.notes: A100 supports FP16/INT8/TensorRT; best for large LLMs and batch inference.

known_issues: Operator coverage lags CUDA; verify with ROCm EP whitelist.
profiles.notes: Use ONNX Runtime ROCm EP; MI300X has large HBM for big models.

known_issues: Limited memory; use external data format for large models.
profiles.notes: Best for edge vision models with TensorRT INT8.

known_issues: OpenVINO GPU plugin must be installed.
profiles.notes: Use OpenVINO FP16 or INT8 for Arc GPUs.

known_issues: Very limited memory; small models and small calibration sets only.
profiles.notes: Quantize to INT8 and keep the model under 2GB.

known_issues: AzureML pipeline requires AML workspace and compute target.
profiles.notes: Cloud inference with ONNX Runtime on Azure NC/ND-series VMs.

known_issues: The tensorrt-rtx package installs the standalone TensorRT RTX EP-ABI provider library implementing NvTensorRTRTXExecutionProvider for ONNX Runtime 1.23+ (not the full TensorRT / nvinfer SDK). Requires SM ≥ 7.5 (Turing+).
PTQ INT8/QDQ path is a poor fit for tensorrt-rtx; prefer AWQ INT4.
profiles.notes: Consumer RTX path via JIT TensorRT engines; distinct from full TensorrtExecutionProvider / nvinfer SDK. Align with Olive Studio provider catalog TRT RTX.

known_issues: NPU plugin requires Intel Core Ultra / Meteor Lake+ with OpenVINO NPU driver.
Unsupported ops fall back to CPU; verify OpenVINO device=NPU.
Olive Studio sets openvinoTargetDevice: "NPU" separately from EP id.
OpenVINOOptimumConversion is torch/HF-only; use OpenVINOConversion for ONNX sources.
profiles.notes: Maps app OpenVINO + NPU device target. Prefer INT8/weight-compression paths documented for OpenVINO. Default chain uses OpenVINOConversion (torch|onnx) before OpenVINOWeightCompression.

known_issues: Windows 10/11 + DirectX 12 only; needs onnxruntime-directml.
Operator coverage differs from CUDA; validate graph.
profiles.notes: Olive Studio default-family venv path for DirectML. Prefer INT8 PTQ. Do not mix CUDA/TRT packages into this EP path.

known_issues: Browser WebGPU only (ORT Web); not a local Olive CLI/EP execution target in Studio.
Olive Studio blocks local run for WebGPU (isRunnable: false / localExecutionIssues).
INT8 support varies by browser/GPU.
profiles.notes: Export/optimize ONNX for in-browser ORT Web WebGPU. Prefer FP16. Use Studio for recipe build/export, not Execute Live.

known_issues: OWR / ORT Mobile CPU backend only; not a local Olive Studio Execute Live EP.
Prefer as mobile CPU fallback beside NNAPI.
profiles.notes: Export-target profile. Recommend FP16/INT8 export chains similar to WebGPU, not CUDA AWQ.

known_issues: ORT Web WASM CPU path; not a local Olive Python EP.
Often paired as WebGPU fallback in OWR web configs.
profiles.notes: Export-target profile for browser CPU. Prefer FP16; keep graphs small.

known_issues: Legacy Qualcomm SNPE / DLC path; prefer QNNExecutionProvider for new Snapdragon work.
Not available for Studio Execute Live.
profiles.notes: Legacy export profile. MCP should prefer QNN hardware guidance; keep SNPE only for DLC conversion recipes.

known_issues: Olive has no first-class .tflite emitter in this catalog; this profile prepares ONNX for external TFLite tooling.
Not a local Olive Execute Live EP — export/recipe only.
Operator coverage differs from ONNX ORT EPs.
profiles.notes: ONNX preparation profile for external TensorFlow Lite conversion (e.g. onnx2tf / TFLite converter). Studio marks TensorflowLiteExecutionProvider as an export target; do not treat the recommended Olive passes as a complete .tflite export chain.

known_issues: MIGraphX operator subset coverage: models with custom ops or dynamic control flow may fall back to ROCm EP.
Custom-op and dynamic-control-flow graphs are not supported by MIGraphX graph compilation.
profiles.notes: MIGraphX performs graph-level compilation (analogous to TensorRT), preferred over ROCm EP when model operators are within MIGraphX coverage.

known_issues: RDNA 4 (gfx12) has experimental ROCm support; stability and operator coverage may change between driver releases.
Operator coverage is narrower than CDNA-based Instinct GPUs — AWQ, mixed-precision FP16 accumulation, and structured 2:4 sparsity are unsupported.
ROCm driver versions below 6.2 may produce incorrect results or fail to load models on RDNA 4.
profiles.notes: Consumer Radeon relies on community-maintained ROCm builds, narrower operator coverage than Instinct. Prefer GPTQ over AWQ for quantization on RDNA architectures.
